sloka: तस्माद्राजगृहादेव वनं गच्छतु ते सुतः ।एतद्धि रोचते मह्यं भृशं चापि हितं तव ॥२-८-३३॥
transliteration: tasmādrājagṛhādeva vanaṁ gacchatu te sutaḥ ।etaddhi rocate mahyaṁ bhṛśaṁ cāpi hitaṁ tava ॥2-8-33॥

translations.english: Therefore let your son go to the forest straight from his uncle's palace only. That alone will please me. For you also this is highly beneficial.
